rules.coordinates: physical XZ = fully composed shipped glTF world (x,z), meters; no axis conversion
rules.tree_shape: 16-gon circumscribed around root-centered enclosing circle of clipped bark slab; 0.000003m quantization guard
rules.stone_shape: Convex XZ hull of selected stone geometry, including embedded stone; no canopy/moss decoration
rules.excluded: Canopy, grass, flowers, reeds, logs/stumps, arches, lanterns, banners, bridge meshes, terrain, roads, base surfaces and live structures
rules.clearance: Geometry is uninflated; client/server navigation applies actor clearance once

static_access.scope: Both hero spawns, three camps, two bosses and six tower anchors; static geometry only
